text: なら　ポケモンが　２ひき　いるぜ

structure.jp: ポケモンが　２ひき　いるぜ

patterns.name: 〜がいる (need)
patterns.span: ポケモンが　２ひき　いる
patterns.explanation: This いる is 要る 'to be needed', not 'to exist'; the needed thing takes が. ポケモンが　２ひき　いる = 'you need two Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, boyish way of telling someone something. いるぜ = 'you need them, man'.
